name: Gary Whittington
fact: The Talisman prints his given name two ways in the same volume. The Rules and Elections caption on p. 68 calls him Gary Whittington; the Alpha Phi Omega service caption on p. 52 calls him Greg K. Whittington, and the back index enters him as Whittington, Gregory K. Only one Whittington appears in the index, so these are one person. Flagged, not resolved.

name: Cathy Ashabraner
fact: She was treasurer of the senior class in 1970-71 as well as sitting on the A.S. Rules and Elections Committee. Her senior portrait entry reads Senior Class treas.; A.S. Rules and Elections Committee, and the class officers caption names Kathy Ashabraner, treas.

name: Phil Myers
fact: He was president of the senior class in 1970-71, having been junior class president the year before. His senior portrait entry reads Senior Class President; Junior Class President, and the class officers caption names Phil Myers, pres.

name: Georgenna Sleamaker
fact: The Talisman spells her given name Georganna. The officers caption on p. 31 of the 1970 volume reads GEORGANNA SLEAMAKER, Secretary, and the features staff credit in the 1969 volume reads GEORGANNA SLEAMAKER, Editor. The archive currently carries Georgenna. Flagged, not resolved.

src.label: 1970 Talisman pt. 1, p. 31; 1969 Talisman pt. 1, features staff

name: Tonii Rizzo
fact: The 1969 Talisman spells him two ways on facing pages. The officers caption on p. 96 reads Toni Rizzo, Treasurer; the Executive Committee caption on p. 97 reads Tonii Rizzo, and the nameplate on his desk in the p. 96 photograph reads TONII. Flagged, not resolved.

name: Michael Klein
fact: The senior class list in the 1969 Talisman prints his given name as Michale, not Michael, with the major Business Administration and home town Westfield, New Jersey. The Associated Students group caption in the 1968 Talisman prints Michael Klein. Flagged, not resolved.

name: Carol Bass
fact: She was already in the Associated Students in 1966-67, a year earlier than the archive records her. The group caption on p. 136 of the 1967 Talisman lists Carol Bass in the second row. The archive currently has her first serving in 1967-68.

name: Michael Klein
fact: He appears in the Associated Students group caption for 1966-67 as Mike Klein, second row, consistent with the archive's record of him representing the men's residence halls that year.

name: Catlette Evans
fact: His full name was Catlette Thompson Evans, of Tompkinsville, and he read History and Speech. He was a man; the class portrait row runs woman, man, man, man against the four names and he is the third. He graduated in 1968.

name: Patricia Lanning / Carla Dotson / Pat Smith
fact: CLOSED, 10 November 2026. The 1967 Talisman's Associated Students group photograph, p. 136 (dlsc_ua_records/382, viewcontent article=1382), names all 26 people in the photo by row: Third Row: Catlette Evans, Ron Griffee, John Adams, Jim Cobb, Terry Hicks, Bob Patterson, Marilee Jenson, Ron Beck. Second Row: Dale Weaver, Wenky Menser, Dave White, Vivian Denton, Pat Lanning, Kaye McClellan, Carol Bass, Dennis Reeves, Mike Klein. First Row (seated): Rita Sutton, Jerry Pence, Bucky Lanning, Larry Heishman, Jim Haynes, Jim Fox, Carmen Willoughby, Marshall Peace, Carla Sue Franklin. Patricia Lanning (as 'Pat Lanning') is named in the Second Row, but that row is one of the photograph's two standing rows, which do not resolve to a clean left-to-right reading (checked against a pixel grid) - and every other Second Row name already on file (Dale Weaver, Vivian Denton, Dennis Reeves, Michael Klein, Carol Bass) is sourced to a different photograph entirely, never this one, which is this project's own quiet evidence that the standing rows here have never been safely readable. Not used for Lanning. Carla Dotson and Pat Smith are not named anywhere on this page at all - not in this caption, and not in any of the four individually captioned committee photographs on the facing page 137 (Student Activities, Finance, Judicial Council, Rules and Elections). See .research/photo-run-2026-11-10-third-scheduled.md for the full reasoning.

name: Mike McDaniel
fact: CLOSED NEGATIVE, 10 November 2026. His existing src, UA3/3/1 'Associated Student Government Officers 1967-68' (dlsc_ua_records/508, viewcontent article=1508), was fetched and rendered in full: it is a three-page typed address-and-phone-number roster with no photograph of any kind, just his name, title and 1351 College Street address. The 1968 Talisman's whole Associated Students section (dlsc_ua_records/384, viewcontent article=1384, pp. 152-155) was also read page by page as rendered images rather than trusted from its garbled OCR layer: the 20-person group photograph on p. 153, captioned by row (Fourth Row: Tom Evans, Steve Stephens, Bill Straeffer, Skip Gaines, Terry Gilpin, Earl Edmonds; Third Row: Michael Klein, Steve Reeves, Frank Genzianelli, Carmen Willoughby; Second Row: Susan Streible, Randi Jensen, Johnny Graham, Bonnie Jo Cheron, Becky Cooper, Margaret Brockman; First Row: Ron Beck, William Menser, Claudia Fowler, Larry Heishman), and all six individually captioned committee photographs on pp. 154-155 (Executive, Publicity, Rules and Elections, Student Activities, Judicial Council, Finance Committees) were each read by eye. McDaniel is named in none of them, despite being the other Campus Representative at Large (Keith Petrie, the second, is also absent from every photograph on these pages). Both documentary leads this office's own citation and the Talisman's full organizational spread for his exact year are now exhausted without a photograph.
